verdict.rationale: Dagster documents its own alerting (Dagster+ alerts that notify you of critical events, plus alert policies on run metrics) and in-code run logging via context.log, and it orchestrates syncs such as Airbyte connections. The evidence does not name the delivery channels (Slack, email, webhook), and it never shows per-sync run status views or row counts. Alerting is also documented only for the Dagster+ commercial offering. missing for 10: documented Slack/email/webhook alert destinations, per-sync run status UI evidence, row-count metadata per sync, alerting for OSS deployments, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I see run status, logs, and row counts per sync, and failures alert me in Slack, email, or a webhook

citations.quote: Dagster+ alerts can notify you of critical events occurring in your deployment so you can catch potential issues early
alert policies can now target deployment capacity metrics — queued runs and in-progress runs
you can trigger Airbyte syncs and orchestrate your Airbyte connections from within Dagster
